sources.title: 2025 Gazetteer Files — ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (national)
List 1: Core Based Statistical Areas (CBSAs), Metropolitan Divisions, and Combined Statistical Areas (CSAs)

state_fips_table: Census/NIST FIPS 5-2 state numeric codes -> USPS abbreviations (static reference table, inlined in the build script)
notes: Keyed by 2020 Census ZCTA (ZIP Code Tabulation Area), which approximates but is not identical to a USPS ZIP code.
PO-box-only ZIPs, unique ZIPs assigned to a single organization, and some newly-issued ZIPs typically have no ZCTA and so are absent here; callers must fall back to ZIP3/state (never guess a county).
county share (sh) is land-area share of the ZCTA in that county (AREALAND_PART / total ZCTA land area), rounded to 4 decimals; the primary county (p) is the largest share.
cb is null when the primary county is not part of any CBSA (rural/non-metro/non-micro county) — this is correct, not missing data.

pl (place) is a best-effort display name only (largest-land-share Census place overlapping the ZCTA per the ZCTA-to-Place relationship file) and must never be used for jurisdiction/legal determinations — only co/p (county) is authoritative for that.
